bio: Fitness and athleisure on the beach: sunrise sessions, rope workouts and a very strong coffee. Fashion for moving.
avatar: Portrait of a fit athletic woman in her early 30s with a high ponytail and a sports top, light sweat and a determined smile, beach gym at sunrise, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of an outdoor beach gym at sunrise with ropes, rings and a barbell, a lone athlete silhouette in the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Beach workout at sunrise
videos.description: Rope slams, burpees and a pink horizon.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of an athletic woman in sportswear doing battle-rope slams on a beach at sunrise, spray and sand in the air, pink sky, fictional adults clearly over 25, tasteful, energetic, cinematic, seen from the side, no text
videos.motion: She slams the heavy ropes in a steady rhythm, sand and spray fly, the sun rises, camera orbits slowly.

videos.title: Athleisure, three looks
videos.description: From gym to brunch in three outfits.

videos.motion: She walks along the street, her jacket and ponytail move, sunlight flickers between buildings, steady camera follow.
